credentials.name: Shopify client credentials
credentials.help: Your Shopify app's client ID and secret (Dev Dashboard > your app > Settings), with read_products and write_products

credentials.name: Slack bot
credentials.help: Your Slack app's bot token (OAuth & Permissions), with chat:write

credentials.name: Slack signing secret
credentials.help: Your Slack app's Signing Secret (Basic Information)

credentials.name: Ollama Cloud
credentials.help: An Ollama API key (ollama.com > Settings > Keys)

credentials.name: DataForSEO
credentials.help: Optional: your DataForSEO API login and API password (dashboard > API Access), only if you turn on use_search

credentials.name: Firecrawl
credentials.help: Your Firecrawl API key (starts with fc-), only if you turn on use_firecrawl

credentials.name: Supabase (Postgres)
credentials.help: Your Supabase database connection string (Connect > Session pooler), for workflow-supabase.json only
